feature_title: Create a FastAPI URL shortener using uv and Python 3.14 (requires-python >=3.14): POST /links takes a URL validated with Pydantic HttpUrl and returns a 6-character code; GET /{code} redirects with 307; GET /links/{code}/stats returns the hit count; links persist in SQLite through the stdlib sqlite3 module at the path in the SHORTENER_DB environment variable; pytest tests using FastAPI's TestClient, verified by uv run pytest -q.
warnings: create_link generates a code via _generate_code (which only checks db.code_exists) and then calls db.create_link with no transaction spanning the check-then-insert and no handling of the sqlite3.IntegrityError a collision on the links.code PRIMARY KEY would raise; a collision between two concurrent requests (astronomically unlikely but possible) surfaces as an unhandled 500 instead of a retry or a clear error

the open-connection/try/finally-close sequence (db.get_connection() ... try: ... finally: conn.close()) is duplicated identically in create_link, link_stats, and follow_link with no shared helper or FastAPI dependency, so any future change to connection handling (pooling, error wrapping, etc.) has to be made in three places
